That the amount recovered by the said Judgment is the sum of Seventy pounds and the sum of five pounds six shillings for costs which together make the sum of Seventy five pounds six shillings , I this deponent further say that to the best of my knowledge and belief the said Robert Ramsay Junior the said defendant is at the time of swearing this affidavit seized or possessed at law or in equity or has disposing power which he may without the assent of any other person exercise for his own benefit over certain lands tenements hereditaments and premises hereinafter mentioned that is to say All that and those that part of the lands of Sallaghagrane in the Parish of Carwall Barony of Kilmacrenan and County of Donegal held under Viscount Southwell at the yearly rent of four pounds five shillings and which said premises were lately in possession of Charles Murray and now in possession of the said Robert Ramsay Junior . And I further say that the sum of Seventy pounds principal money bearing interest from the fourteenth day of May 1881 at the rate of four percent per annum is secured by the said Judgment as aforesaid and that the said sum of seventy pounds principal money together with interest thereon at the rate and from the time aforesaid and five pounds six shillings for costs still remains justly due and owing to me this deponent and the said William Wilson and said Judgment is still in force and effect in law R A Wilson Sworn before me at Strabane in the County of Tyrone this 18 . day of April 1884 a Commissioner of Her Majestys High Court of Justice in Ireland for taking affidavits in and for said Court in said County and I know the deponent Oliver White Commissioner R A Wilson Nolr 60 Upper Sackville St Recd 19th April 1884 D.
